decisive_items: Doughy skin with palpable bilateral piezogenic papules
Normal aortic measurements, tricuspid aortic valve
response.rationale: EDS is supported by Beighton 8/9, doughy skin, piezogenic papules, and joint hypermobility; Marfan is less likely due to normal aortic root and tricuspid valve, and Loeys-Dietz is contradicted by unremarkable MRA without aneurysms.

rejected.why: Normal aortic measurements and tricuspid valve contradict Marfan's typical aortic root dilation; only non-specific features like arm span and palate.
No aneurysms on MRA and no other LDS-specific features; family history of aneurysm is not diagnostic without personal vascular findings.
